sin.name: command-named-for-its-effect
sin.description: A command is named for what it does to a row (MemoryMake, FileEditRecord) instead of as the order it is.
sin.rule: Name a command as an order, its verb first: MakeMemory, RecordFileEdit, StartTask; its handler and subcommand take the same name. A new verb goes into command_verbs in lists.json.
